videos.title: GTA 6 Just Broke Pre-Order Records on PlayStation AND Xbox 🏆 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Sony and Microsoft both said on Nov 10 that GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store history, and Take-Two says pre-orders are tracking far above expectations (no official number yet).

Sources: PlayStation Blog, Xbox Wire, GameSpot, Game Informer, Take-Two earnings call (Nov 9)

videos.description:

videos.title: Is GTA 6 Online Coming on Day One? Here's What We Know 🎮 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Rockstar hasn't announced a date for GTA 6's online multiplayer. Bloomberg's Jason Schreier reported on Oct 14 that it's expected in 2027, and says a 'year later' line in a Nov 13 Bloomberg video came from its scriptwriter, not his sources.

Sources: Bloomberg, VICE, VGTimes
